resources.string: Reflects your personal input, and Gemma prepares public sentences on-device.

Turning this off also stops any preparation in progress and scheduled runs.

Automatic enrichment runs at 30% battery or higher, manual enrichment at 20% or higher. It stops while you\'re typing, or in power saving, severe heat, or low memory conditions. Timing may be delayed by Android\'s scheduling.
Prepares more sentences at once than automatic enrichment. May stop early depending on device conditions.
This also turns off automatic enrichment.
